question: Which divisions of time are invoked as agents in the consecration?
premises: The year is named as a consecrating agent.
The two solstices, months, and two fortnights are named as consecrating agents.
The days are named as consecrating agents.
inference: Multiple divisions of time, from year to day, participate as agents in the consecration.
uncertainties: The governing verb abhiṣiñcantu is supplied from the preceding verse.
plain_english: And may the year, the two solstices, the months, the two fortnights, and the days consecrate you.
